description: Remove one runtime mechanism at a time (no reasoning layer) and test whether downstream behaviour changes beyond the noise replicate.
question: Which runtime mechanisms change downstream behaviour when removed, at which resolution?
manipulated: one runtime flag per variant: memory, retention, transform, wave state, return events, disconnection, reconfiguration, cut, connection creation
measured: status per resolution for each ablated variant vs the full runtime C
does_not_show: Theoretical necessity: a detected effect of removal in this configuration does not show the mechanism is irreducible (see the reduction study, docs/REDUCTION.md, for reductions and compensations); the variants' own event counts differ by construction.
